widgets_values:
MULTI-FACE REFINING - ONE REUSABLE PASS CHAIN, QUEUE ONCE PER SUBJECT

H3 conditions WHOLE-FRAME, not per face: one subject's reference landing on another in a shared frame is why each subject is refined in its own pass and the passes are composited back in the clip, not merged in the latent.

The plan node writes the JOB FOLDER. ONE Subject Select (on 'next') hands the next not-yet-done subject to the tracker. Pass Save checkpoints the crops then the stitched result for THAT subject. H3 Pass Load reads the PREVIOUS subject's stitched pass as this pass's base_images; for the FIRST subject there is none, so it returns the TARGET CLIP wired into its 'no_previous' input. That is how ONE chain serves any number of subjects - no copies. Composite blends nothing: it returns the LAST subject's stitched frames, which already carry every earlier face because each pass composited onto the one before it - and it refuses until every subject's stitched stage is recorded.

HOW TO RUN IT: keep the same job_name and queue once per subject. Each queue refines the subject 'next' picks. Composite raises on every queue but the LAST - that is the completion gate, not a bug; the pass it waited on is already saved, so the next queue resumes where you left off, and the final queue writes the clip. Set Subject Select to a number to re-run one subject.

KEEP THE CHAIN HONEST: wire Subject Select's 'previous_subject' into BOTH H3 Pass Load's subject AND H3 Pass Save's chained_from. It is -1 for the first subject (base = clip) and the previous subject otherwise, exactly what the composite checks. COMPOSITE ORDER is plan order (left to right at the match frame); there is no widget for it.
nodes.title: READ ME FIRST - the pass model

widgets_values:
MODEL FILES THIS TEMPLATE EXPECTS

The same filenames the other two templates ship - swap them for what is in your models folder.

UNETLoader (diffusion_models):  minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
CLIPLoader (text_encoders):     qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
LoraLoaderModelOnly (loras):    minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
VAELoader (vae):                minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
VAELoader (vae):                minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
face detector:                  bbox/face_yolov8m.pt

The LoRA and the step count have to agree: steps=8 on both BasicScheduler nodes, because that LoRA is the 8-step one.

The detector on H3 Multi-Face Plan and on H3 Load Video + Face Select must be the SAME model: the plan pairs the two plates positionally, and two different detectors do not agree about which box belongs to whom.

widgets_values:
THE JOB FOLDER IS THE MEMORY

Everything the passes share lives in <output>/<job_name>/: the plan, the pairing preview, one subject reference PNG each, and passes/subject_0000/{crops, crops.json, stitched}.

A subject counts as done ONLY once its stitched stage is recorded. A pass that died after the crops is re-run, not skipped - crops are cheap to keep and worthless as a result.

Change the match frame, the tolerance, the exclusions, unmatched_faces, max_subjects or either plate size and the nodes refuse, naming what differs: the pairing fingerprint, stopping two pairings from sharing one clip and swapping faces quietly.

Audio: every pass's generated audio is discarded. The save node takes the CLIP's own audio.
